responsibility: Implements tree-SSA value numbering, including SCC-based and reverse-postorder variants, and hosts the FRE pass built on that machinery. It maintains hash tables for numbered n-ary operations, PHIs, references, and memory states, performs optimistic SCC iteration or region/RPO walks to assign value numbers and executable-edge information, folds and combines expressions while tracking available values, eliminates redundancies using the discovered VN state, and exports region-based RPO-VN support used by PRE and loop transforms.
same_name_distinction: This .c file is the implementation side of tree SSA SCC/RPO value numbering and the FRE pass, containing the actual VN tables, SCC and RPO walkers, elimination logic, and pass execution. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-sccvn.h, it does not just declare vn_* data structures and public VN APIs for other passes.
